learning_outcomes.text: Students can evaluate material characteristic values with regard to sample preparation and characteristic value determination in their significance for technical applications.
Students acquire knowledge about different testing and test procedures.
Students can assess the transferability of material characteristic values to component design or component testing.
Students can efficiently apply suitable testing methods for the analytical investigation of component failures and material characteristic values.
Students can systematically analyze a component or product problem and derive suitable improvement measures.
Students learn to work out a test procedure together in a team and to present and apply it accordingly.
Students learn to process an investigation order effectively and efficiently in coordination with other students.

syllabus_topics: Significance of material and component characteristic values for design, simulation, and production
Legal regulations, standards, guidelines, customer requirements, specifications, and performance descriptions
Influence of sample preparation, specimen geometry, testing method, and test parameters on characteristic values
Technological, thermal, rheological, optical, sound and radiation-related, as well as electrical and electromagnetic material and component testing
Methods for investigating aging, weathering, and media resistance
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
